productionPhysical.query: BEGIN READ ONLY; SET LOCAL statement_timeout='20s'; SELECT jsonb_build_object('at',clock_timestamp(),'databaseBytes',pg_database_size(current_database()),'defaultReadOnly',current_setting('default_transaction_read_only'),'maxConnections',current_setting('max_connections'),'tables',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'table',c.relname,'estimatedRows',c.reltuples::bigint,'tableBytes',pg_table_size(c.oid),'indexesBytes',pg_indexes_size(c.oid),'totalBytes',pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(c.oid) DESC) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind IN('r','m') AND n.nspname IN('public','private','word_index','cron','auth','storage')),'storage',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('objects',count(*),'fileBytes',sum((metadata->>'size')::bigint)) FROM storage.objects)) AS proof; COMMIT;

notes: Production-only READ ONLY aggregates; no actual student text.
Future M01/M05 tables absent means not yet installed, not zero current data.
Question counts are structural candidates; final M01 meaning/body registration and current protective predicates must pass after M10 before M08-B.
Every JSON/text byte measure is logical serialized size, not reclaimable file size.
